title: GET /api/v1/events
description: Ring of the latest 16 current-boot events. Resets at boot. Use latest_event_id from /api/v1/status as the 'after' cursor for incremental fetches; pair it with boot_id to detect a restart.

next_after.description: Safe to persist even when events[] is empty; pass back as ?after=<value>.

cursor_reset.description: true when the supplied boot is stale or the cursor is ahead of the device. Response contains the retained current-boot history and the client must replace its cursor.

truncated.description: true when more than 16 events occurred and the requested cursor fell behind the oldest retained item.
